data.name: Usage
data.value:
srcsharp: authoring tools for SRC# data and scenarios
Usage: srcsharp lint <directory or file>... [--format text|sarif] [--output file] [--rules src,gsc-robo,gsc-ext,robodun|none] [--list-rules] [--app-path SRC folder] Check data (*.txt) and events (*.eve). Exit code 1 if problems are found. --rules selects rule groups (default src; rule findings of the information level do not affect the exit code). --list-rules lists the rules srcsharp play <event file> [--script file.play] [--out directory] [--app-path SRC folder] [--scenario-root scenario folder] [--steps count] [--skip-wait] Run a scenario without a screen. Without --script, advance messages and pick the first choice. With --skip-wait, fixed waits (animations, messages, Wait) are skipped. --scenario-root sets the scenario folder (the base of Data, Lib and Continue); by default, an event file in a subfolder without Data uses the nearest parent folder with Data. srcsharp playtest <event file> [--runs n] [--seed n] [--turns n] [--policy smart|advance|hold] [--format md|json] [--output file] [--min-wins n] [--app-path SRC folder] [--scenario-root scenario folder] Check the difficulty: auto-play one episode several times with different random seeds (default 5 runs, up to 30 turns) and report wins, losses, timeouts and stalls, turn counts, lost allies and hints for tuning. Exit code 1 when wins are below --min-wins srcsharp outline [scenario folder or event file] [--format md|json] [--output file] [--app-path SRC folder] Scenario overview: per-episode party and cast (joins, carried units, leaves, lines per speaker), the event list (trigger, when, conditions, actions), variables (where they are set and read) and the script (talk and telops in episode order) srcsharp balance <directory or file>... [--format md|csv] [--output file] List unit data stats and outliers srcsharp new <folder> [--title title] [--episodes count] [--app-path SRC folder] [--force] Create a new scenario template (events, maps and data, autoplay script, VS Code settings, CI). When --episodes is 2 or more, creates multiple episodes with intermission and shared events. Existing files are kept (--force overwrites) srcsharp flow [scenario folder or event file] [--format md|mmd|json] [--output file] [--app-path SRC folder] [--scenario-root scenario folder] Trace Continue, next stage, Exec, IntermissionCommand, Load and GameClear across events and output the episode flow diagram (defaults to the current directory) srcsharp assets [scenario folder] [--format md|json|readme] [--output file] [--app-path SRC folder] [--ext-data folder] [--ext-data2 folder] [--fail-on-missing] List images, sounds and maps referenced by data and events, with where they are referenced and where they were found in SRC search order (scenario, extended data, SRC). Also lists names built from expressions and unreferenced files. readme drafts a "Required assets" section for README. --fail-on-missing exits with 1 if any asset is missing (does not obtain or redistribute assets) srcsharp trial <scenario folder> [--unit unit] [--pilot pilot] [--enemy unit] [--enemy-pilot pilot] [--level n] [--enemies n] [--list] Create a trial battle event in .srcsharp/trial/ that fights units and pilots from the scenario data against an enemy, and print its path (run it with play or the debugger). --list prints the units and pilots as JSON srcsharp event-flow <event file> [--format md|mmd|json] [--output file] [--app-path SRC folder] [--scenario-root scenario folder] Trace event triggers, labels, Call, Goto and Require across one event file (and its includes and Requires) and output an event flow diagram srcsharp talk-preview <event file> [--line line] [--block index] [--stdin] [--input file] [--format json|png] [--out directory] [--output file] [--no-images] [--app-path SRC folder] [--scenario-root scenario folder] Render Talk and AutoTalk blocks using the game message window and output per-page PNG images or JSON srcsharp anime-preview <file or folder> [--list] [--file file] [--line line] [--kind animation|ext_animation|effect|subroutine] [--target name] [--situation situation] [--spec spec] [--attacker unit] [--attacker-pilot pilot] [--defender unit] [--defender-pilot pilot] [--play-once] [--out image file] [--app-path SRC folder] [--scenario-root scenario folder] Prepare .srcsharp/preview/ to play one animation.txt, ext_animation.txt, effect.txt entry or generic battle animation subroutine with fixed attacker and defender units. --list outputs entries as JSON, --play-once plays it once srcsharp lsp Language Server (stdio) srcsharp dap Debugger (Debug Adapter Protocol, stdio) srcsharp help [topic] [--list] [--search text [--limit count] [--method hybrid|bm25|vector]] [--grep text] [--export directory] Show the SRC# help (reference for data, event commands, functions, etc., Japanese Markdown). --list lists topics, --search finds pages ranked by relevance, --grep prints lines containing the text, --export writes all pages
Common options: --lang <ja|en|zh-Hans|...|auto> Display language. Can also be set with the SRCSHARP_LANG environment variable (the option wins). Default is ja; auto follows the OS setting --log-level <Trace|Debug|Information|Warning|Error>, -v, -vv Log level (play, lsp, dap). -v is Debug, -vv is Trace. Can also be set with SRCSHARP_LOG_LEVEL. Default is Information --log-dir <folder>, --no-log-file Folder for log files. --no-log-file disables the log file. Can also be set with SRCSHARP_LOG_DIR and SRCSHARP_LOG_FILE (On|Off)
